import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;
public class Prac {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int b = sc.nextInt();
        int i, j = 0;
        int count = 0;
        int arr[] = new int[n];
        int cut[] = new int[n];
        for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            arr[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        int even = 0, odd = 0;
        for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (arr[i] % 2 == 0)
                even++;
            else
                odd++;
            if (even == odd && i != n - 1) {
                cut[j] = i + 1;
                even = odd = 0;
                j++;
            }
        }
        if (j > 1) {
            int bitcoin[] = new int[j];
            for (i = 0; i < j; i++) {
                bitcoin[i] = arr[cut[i]] - arr[cut[i] - 1];
                if (bitcoin[i] < 0)
                    bitcoin[i] = -bitcoin[i];
            }
            Arrays.sort(bitcoin);
            if (bitcoin[0] > b)
                count = 0;
            else {
                for (i = 1; i < j; i++) {
                    bitcoin[i] += bitcoin[i - 1];
                    if (bitcoin[i] > b) {
                        count = i;
                        break;
                    } else
                        count = i + 1;
                }
            }
        } else {
            if (j == 0)
                count = 0;
            else {
                int a = arr[cut[0]] - arr[cut[0] - 1];
                if (a < 0)
                    a = -a;
                if (j == 1 && a >= b)
                    count = 1;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(count);
    }
}
